dqTime.title: We may not be able to help
dqTime.msg: Claims older than 12 months often fall outside the statute of limitations in most states. We recommend speaking with a local attorney to confirm your options — there may still be a path forward depending on your state.

dqInjury.title: We're glad you're okay!
dqInjury.msg: Since you weren't injured, there likely isn't a personal injury claim to pursue. However, if you experienced any pain or symptoms in the days after — even mild ones — it may still be worth a quick consultation with an attorney.

dqFault.title: We can't proceed with this case
dqFault.msg: If you were fully at fault, pursuing a personal injury claim against the other party isn't possible. However, you may still have options — consult with a local attorney who can review the full details of your situation.

dqAttorney.title: You're already in good hands
dqAttorney.msg: Since you already have legal representation, we can't assist at this time. If you're unhappy with your current attorney or want a second opinion, feel free to come back — we work with top-rated accident lawyers across the country.
